case_text: SYNTHETIC CASE (fictional). 52-year-old woman, newly confirmed hypertension (home average 156/96 mmHg over 7 days). Asthma since childhood, two hospital admissions in the last 3 years, uses a salbutamol inhaler most days. No diabetes. Kidney function and potassium normal. Not pregnant. No other medicines.

must_catch.why: A beta-blocker can trigger bronchospasm in asthma.

must_not_claim.why: Beta-blockers are not first choice and are risky with asthma.
